Title: Mobile first
Statement: The portal is designed for the phone first and works on larger screens too.
Rationale: Most restaurant owners order on their phone, late in the evening after service.

Title: No online payment in the first version
Statement: Customers do not pay online; the monthly invoice stays as it is today.
Rationale: All Alpine Fresh customers are on a monthly invoice, and that stays (Jonas Meier, call 16 Oct).

Title: Orders reach the ERP through the 18:30 CSV import
Statement: The portal produces a CSV file of the day's orders for the existing ERP import every evening at 18:30.
Rationale: Alpine Fresh already imports a CSV file at 18:30, so the ERP needs no change.

Title: The portal enforces the 18:00 order cut-off
Statement: Orders sent after 18:00 go to the next delivery day of the customer's route.
Rationale: The order form sets the cut-off at 18:00 and delivers later orders on the next possible delivery day.
